When the customizer enables the recursive‑anchor flag, the validator should still succeed for a conforming document, covering the branch that checks `isRecursiveAnchor()`.
Disabling the schema‑resource‑root flag exercises the branch that decides whether to treat the current schema as a resource root.

Schema is the boolean literal true (accepts any JSON). Validation should always succeed regardless of the document.

cases.expected: set containing message: ['instance does not match schema (boolean false)']
cases.description: Schema is the boolean literal false (rejects any JSON). Validation must always return a failure message.
Schema combines multiple constraints: "id" must match UUID pattern, "age" integer minimum 18, "email" format "email". All constraints satisfied → no messages.

cases.expected: set containing messages: ['pattern mismatch for property id', 'value 15 is less than minimum 18 for property age', 'format validation failed for property email']
cases.description: Same schema as above but each property violates a different constraint, exercising pattern, minimum, and format validation branches.
